d:
Batatyache Kaap, made the authentic Maharashtrian way! Thinly sliced potatoes coated in a simple, flavourful masala and cooked until perfectly crispy, this is one of my favourite accompaniments to a comforting dal-rice meal.
The recipe is super quick, uses simple ingredients, and turns out absolutely delicious. Do give it a try!
The full written recipe is in the description below. Happy Cooking!
Batatyache Kaap
Prep Time: 20–25 minutes
Cooking Time: 15–20 minutes
Serving: 3–4
